test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains a spelling error.

I was alarmed lest we should be wreked.
solution: The correct answer is **Option 4)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"wreked"** is incorrect and does not exist in the English language. (गलत शब्द) • **Example: **There is no valid example because **"wreked"** is not a correct word. • The correct word is **"wrecked"**, which means **to be destroyed or ruined, especially in the context of a ship.** (नष्ट हुआ) • **Example: **The ship was **wrecked** in the storm. Therefore, the correct answer is: ***'be wrecked.'*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **I was** (मैं था): Refers to the past state of being of the speaker. • **Example:** I was happy to see my old friends. (मैं अपने पुराने दोस्तों को देखकर खुश था।) • **we should** (हमें चाहिए): Suggests a recommendation or obligation for the group including the speaker. • **Example:** We should finish our homework before playing. (हमें खेलने से पहले अपना होमवर्क खत्म करना चाहिए।) • **alarmed lest** (डर गया कि): Indicates a fear or concern that something undesirable might happen. • **Example:** She was alarmed lest her secret be discovered. (वह डर गई कि कहीं उसका रहस्य पता न चल जाए।) 48:Tbcf, The correct answer is **Option 3)**
